The first public build of the **manager app**: the desktop program that puts games on a Tilt-a-tron and takes them off again.

The watch itself installs from a web page, no download needed: <https://partiallyfrozen.github.io/tilt-a-tron/>

## Download

| You have | Take | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `tiltatron-manager-v0.8.0-windows-x64.exe` | Double-click it. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `tiltatron-manager-v0.8.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf` it, then see the note below. |
| Linux x64 | `tiltatron-manager-v0.8.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf` it and run `./tiltatron-manager`. |

Each is one self-contained file, about 40 MB - that is what it costs to need no .NET runtime installed. Plug the watch in with a cable that carries data, wake it, and the app finds it.

**These builds are not code-signed**, so each system will say so once:

- **Windows** shows "Windows protected your PC". Choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- **macOS** refuses to open it. Clear the download flag first: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine tiltatron-manager`
- **Linux** needs permission to use the serial port. On most distributions: `sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER`, then sign out and back in.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file, if you want to check what you downloaded.

## What it does

- Shows what is **on the watch** beside **your library** - a plain folder of `.tat` game files in your documents. Drag a game from one to the other, or drop `.tat` files in from anywhere.
- **Nothing is lost on the first click.** Taking a game off the watch moves it to the library, and the copy is read back from disk before the watch's file is deleted. Deleting from the library itself asks twice.
- Installs and removals show up on the watch **without a restart**, and your scores are still there when a game comes back.
- Sends themes, and backs up everything on the watch.
- Given arguments it is a command-line tool: `list`, `library`, `add`, `install`, `save`, `uninstall`, `send`, `remove`.

## Needs firmware 0.8.0

This release goes with firmware 0.8.0, the first in which every game is an installable package:

- Ten games, all removable and installable: Breakout, Marble Maze, Grand Prix, Sky Jump, Tilt-a-tris, Sleepy Star, Pin Drop, Starfall, Skater Girlz and the new **Echo**.
- Every game has its own icon, on the watch and in the app.
- Only one game is held in memory at a time, so playing all ten in a sitting no longer runs the watch out of it.
- Sleep holds while the watch is plugged in: the screen goes dark and stays dark.
- A new watch says SETTING UP while it installs its games, instead of showing nothing for half a minute.

Want to write a game? It is a folder of plain C, an icon and one script: see [Write a game](https://github.com/PartiallyFrozen/tilt-a-tron#write-a-game).

## Known

- Dragging between the panes has been tested far less than the buttons that do the same thing. If a drag misbehaves, the buttons will not - and please open an issue.
- Sending files to the watch over USB is slow (about 9 KB/s). A game takes a couple of seconds; a large theme takes half a minute.
